_help: Rules for protect_kicad_v2.py. Each block is checked deny > ask > allow, like Claude Code. Globs: ** crosses folders, * and ? do not cross '/'. Matching is case-insensitive on '/'-normalized paths, so one glob covers 'Schematics' and 'schematic'. Edit this file to change protection; no code change needed. Check it with Hardware-Copilot tools/check_permissions.py.

pdf._help: PDF reads by Read and shell commands (cat, pdftotext, python, ...). deny > ask > allow; a PDF that matches no glob is ask. Defaults: schematic, PCB, fabrication and assembly plots are denied; datasheets and other PDFs ask; the project's reports and scratchpad output are allowed.

git._help: Named checks on git and gh commands, with flags in any order. Move a name between deny and ask, or drop it, to change the rule. Names: push-protected, force-push, force-with-lease, push-delete, push-tags, reset-hard, clean-force, branch-delete, branch-rename, tag, rebase, commit-amend, gh-pr-merge, gh-release.
